translated_text: Pariste, May 2, 1940. My dear Mrs. Mekze [illegible] telegraphed me to tell me that she flew in the morning for [illegible] and hasn't received anything from her son for [illegible] days and that she is very afraid that something has happened to her. She has serious reasons to believe this. Would you be very kind and go and tell Uncle Agole and see what Guilz is doing? Telegraph then my friend [illegible] £18 Violet what he has heard or if Julch is well. Do that, my dear, Julch, do it for no reason. Day Anjourel. I [illegible] paid the bill for [illegible] [illegible] Wellington, Hya [illegible] 2380 only for shipping. That's more expensive than the Hyposulfite (10 kps). Isn't it the advertisement that owes all this? But is it [illegible] Pay? Write to me as soon as possible to tell me what you have Ait Spira about our [illegible] money [illegible] my little FM TEN!
